# Week 4 Start/Sit Briefing — Wednesday, 2026-09-30

## Source and freshness

**Live overlay on a fresh committed fixture.** Projections, `playProbability` and injury designations come from `weekly-report-week-4.json`, regenerated 2026-09-29T15:53:54Z (Monday afternoon, after Week 3's Monday-night finale, with FantasyPros consensus and ESPN injuries — not a sandbox-degraded run). Overlaid with a live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` pull at 2026-09-30T20:08Z for this week's practice participation.

**Why this differs from Monday's briefing:** Monday's 06:21Z run had no usable fixture yet (the checked-in Week 4 file predated the season) and fell back to a live, sandbox-degraded `generate_report.py` run with no FantasyPros consensus. That gap has since closed — CI regenerated the real fixture Monday afternoon. This briefing uses it, which is why several point estimates moved even where the lineup slot didn't (Taylor 18.25→19.33, JSN 22.06→20.48, Likely 12.71→10.31), and why the swap below happened.

## Practice report

**No rostered player has a Week 4 report yet.** Only CLE and PIT have filed (their Thursday 10/1 game) — 10 rows total, none of them our players or their upcoming opponents. Every team carrying a rostered player (NYG, IND, TB, SEA, GB, LAC, PHI, LAR, CIN, DET, ATL, LV) has not filed for Week 4. That means today's headline — the DNP/Limited/Full split for Questionable players — is empty this week; every "Healthy" designation below is a Week-3-carryover placeholder, not a fresh Week 4 signal.

One exception worth flagging even without a filed report: **Brock Bowers (bench TE, LV)** carries a P(play) of 0.801 — the lowest of anyone in the optimal lineup — purely from the availability model's memory of his Weeks 1–3 trend (Out → Doubtful → Questionable, DNP each week). His fixture designation still reads "Healthy" because no fresh report exists yet. Worth re-checking once LV files, expected Thu/Fri.

**Jaxson Dart (QB, NYG)** is the one player with a real, independently-confirmed status: his roster entry is flagged `RES` (reserve/IR) via `nflreadpy.load_rosters()`, consistent with the season-ending knee injury carried forward in every briefing since 2026-09-23. He is not in this week's injury report because no team files a fresh weekly report on a player already out for the year. His fixture P(play) is 0.002.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | @PHI | 15.45 | 0.962 | 16.06 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs WAS | 19.33 | 0.940 | 20.57 |
| RB | Cam Skattebo | vs ARI | 13.64 | 0.940 | 14.52 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs LAC | 20.48 | 0.959 | 21.35 |
| WR | Drake London | @NO | 15.49 | 0.959 | 16.15 |
| TE | Brock Bowers | vs KC | 12.16 | 0.801 | 15.19 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | vs JAX | 13.88 | 0.959 | 14.47 |
| FLEX | Bucky Irving | vs GB | 13.52 | 0.940 | 14.39 |
| K | Cameron Dicker | @SEA | 5.39 | 0.981 | 5.49 |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | vs LAR | 3.85 | 1.000 | 3.85 |

**Total: 133.19 expected points** (within the 100–140 sanity band).

Bench: Josh Downs (12.13), Matthew Golden (11.72), Isaiah Likely (10.31), Jameson Williams (10.16), Jaxson Dart (0.02, IR-bound).

Note on Bowers at TE over Likely: it's an expected-value call, not a safe one. Bowers' 12.16 expected already has his 0.801 play probability baked in and still clears Likely's 10.31 (which carries a safer 0.934). If you want the higher floor instead of the higher mean, Likely is the alternative — see Still Uncertain.

## Changes since Monday

- **Start Cam Skattebo (13.64 exp), bench Isaiah Likely (10.31 exp) — net +3.33.** Monday's degraded sandbox run had no FantasyPros consensus for either player and had Likely starting at 12.71. Today's fixture carries real consensus numbers for both: Skattebo's 13.64 clears Likely's 10.31 by enough to swap the TE-vs-flex math (Bowers now fills the TE slot outright, Skattebo takes the second RB/flex spot, Likely drops to bench).
- Everyone else's slot is unchanged from Monday, but most point estimates shifted (see Source and freshness) — none of those shifts changed a start/sit call on their own.

## Still uncertain

- **Brock Bowers vs Isaiah Likely at TE.** Mathematically Bowers wins on expected value (12.16 vs 10.31), but he's started zero games in 2026 and carried an Out/Doubtful/Questionable designation in Weeks 1–3. If LV's Thursday/Friday practice report shows a DNP, re-open this — Likely becomes the start.
- **Jaxson Dart / IR.** Still sitting in the roster's nominal QB starter slot in `roster.json`, not moved to IR, despite being out for the season. This has been flagged in every briefing since 2026-09-23 (Sat 9/26, Mon 9/28) and remains unresolved. Costs a bench spot until it's moved.
- Every "Healthy" tag above is a placeholder pending Thursday/Friday reports for 11 of our 12 relevant teams — none has filed for Week 4 yet.

## Opponent notes

- **NYG @ ARI (Sun 1pm) is a three-player stack**: Dart (IR, doesn't matter), Skattebo (starting RB) and Likely (bench TE) are all Giants. A bad NYG game script this week only costs one active slot (Skattebo) since Likely isn't starting, but it's worth remembering the correlation risk next time Likely is in the lineup too.
- **Stafford (LAR) faces our own Eagles D/ST** (Eagles D/ST vs LAR, Sun 1pm) — a good day for the Eagles defense is a bad day for our own starting QB, and vice versa. Partially self-hedging, not actionable.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 6:** Tee Higgins (CIN), Jameson Williams (DET) — both currently rostered, Higgins a starter. Plan a Week 5 waiver claim if no in-lineup replacement is available.
